item.tib: rig 'dzin 'dus pa thabs chen mkha' yi rgyud las sgrub gzhung phun tshogs ngo mtshar rgyas pa
item.coloph: rig 'dzin 'dus pa thabs chen mkha' yi rgyud las/ dpon gsas bla ma'i sgrub pa/ phun 'tshogs (tshogs) ngo mtshar rgyas pa'i gzhung zhes bya ba/ 'chi med gtsug phud kyi lung don/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i (mkhas) gtan la phab cing / rjes 'jug grol thob kyi rig 'dzin brgyad la gdams pa'o// phyis bstan pa dar nub kyi dus su/ stang dmu tsha gyer med kyis gnyer nas/ bka' gter gnyis su phyes ste (te)/ phyis 'byung dar ba'i smon lam btab cing / phyi rabs las ldan gyi skyes bu (mchan blo ldan snying po) la brgyud nas gdab (gdams) pa'o/ gsang ba'i man ngag u tra sig/
